_comment: Path aliases for the design-sync bundler ONLY. The app still builds from tsconfig.app.json; this exists because the converter strips comments from the tsconfig with a regex that does not understand strings, so the /* inside the "@/" alias opens a phantom block comment which then closes on the */ inside tsconfig.app.json's "src/**/*.test.ts" exclude glob. The parse throws, the paths plugin returns null, and every @/ import fails to resolve with no warning. This file deliberately contains no */ sequence anywhere, so it survives that stripper.
